title: Crossing distances and quantum reflection groups
description: Paper (40 pages, PDF and LaTeX source) and code for its computations. The easy quantum groups between the unitary group and the free unitary group, coming from pairings whose strings may cross only at certain distances, are indexed by the additive semigroups D of natural numbers. To each of them we associate a quantum reflection group between the hyperoctahedral group and its free version, generated by the hyperoctahedral group and by diagonal group duals, coming from reflections placed on the integer line, which commute exactly at the distances in D. This correspondence is one-to-one, it reverses inclusions, and D can be recovered from the diagonal tori of either partner. When D contains 0 the two partners generate the free unitary group, in any dimension at least 3. We compute the laws of the main characters, which are sums of a Poisson number of reflections, respectively shifted mixed Gaussian variables, and we relate them to each other. We also discuss the first dimension where two reflection partners differ.
